core_obligations: Weak convergence at each time does not give Wasserstein convergence uniform on the half-line. The source-independent criterion couples uniform fourth-moment tails, long-time convergence of particles and limit, equilibrium chaos and uniform temporal continuity, then applies the full argument to constant-noise log gases under the printed initial-continuity condition.
